summary.overview.note: The extracted value states 'about 50 chemical plants' but the number 50 in the cited pages (p.7) refers to comment letters received, not the number of plants subject to the standard. summary.project_description.evidence_quote: For a typical average-sized ethylene dichloride-vinyl chloride plant, the standard will reduce hourly vinyl chloride emissions from 176 kg to 10 kg. This is approximately a 94 percent reduction. For a typical average-sized polyvinyl chloride plant, the hourly vinyl chloride emissions will be reduced from 330 kg to 16 kg, or by approximately 95 percent.
summary.project_description.note: All figures (176→10 kg, 330→16 kg, 94%, 95%, 400 ppm, 2000 ppm, 10 ppm) verify against cited pages 9, 55, 78, 80. 'Best available control technology' language verified on p. 99. Section 112 and CAA context verified on p. 7.
